claims.claim: Reviewers find the user interface and menu system overly complicated, poorly designed, and difficult to navigate.

citations.review_text: Complex interface, no new features or game styles to explore. Unnecessary additions just to make something different, but just making a bad experience. The game goes blank most of the time i try to play. Overall, frustrating feeling and no satisfaction. Should have learned from all the negative reviews given by fellow gamers.

UX/UI

User Experience is poorly designed so that you really don't know where to go, what to engage with, or what is important. Game Modes are lazily laid in different sub menus each with new tutorials and their own unique menus that don't let you navigate properly out of them, as if they are intentional independent game types while others share some data between them. As a new player to this game it is confusing to what their goal is and what you should engage with. 

As a micro transaction product, it's also confusing to know which transactions are useful.

The controls for controller are decent but overly re-use inputs that for offense and defense are counter intuitive so remapping is key. Keyboard and mouse is clearly an after thought for the design team and is a terrible experience. Menu's with keyboard and mouse are a nightmare as the mouse scrolling speed cannot be adjusted in the game and the mouse hides itself in the upper top left after a few seconds so you are constantly pulling it back. Playing with a mouse and keyboard in anything other than fullscreen with more than one monitor will pull your mouse to the outside of the screen and cause you to screw up your passing. It's confusing why this part of the product isn't seeing more attention to navigate players to a smooth clear experience. 

Gameplay 

The gameplay struggles with it's own AI, fighting you a times and helping you too much at other times. It feels like the AI is purposely making your experience un-fun by changing it's balancing at strange times and even in game to penalize you. The goalie is a terrible position and any striker remotely decent inside the box can score. The players receiving passes stop after you select the input to pass, why aren't they keeping moving in the direction of your pass like a through pass. Through passes go right to the opponent team if you don't lead far away. It doesn't seem like player techniques work properly. Physicality is random it feels like and everything…

This game runs like absolute ♥♥♥♥. Haven’t bought a fifa game since 23 and I see nothing has changed since then. Same bugs 3 years later. The menu is absolutely horrid and takes forever to load. What a poorly optimized overcomplicated mess. I got it as a gift from a friend. Only reason I have it.
horrible decision making at EA. UI is terrible. Nothing new about the game since 2014

claims.claim: Reviewers report severe optimization issues, noting that menus are laggy and require disabling background videos and cutscenes to function.

citations.review_text:
[h2]2/5[/h2]

Last FIFA game I bought was FIFA 16. After that one, I said "NEVER AGAIN”. It's been 10 years since then. Many things around the franchise changed. But this year, I bought it because I saw a couple of friends playing it. I missed the feeling of building the Ultimate Team.

My verdict? I don’t think there is one single online game as broken as FC 26. Simply nothing about this game is even remotely functional. The game keeps throwing so much random sh*t at you which your mind could never have foreseen. There are so many things wrong with this game that I simply can’t address them all. And it’s barely football. It’s so arcadey, there is nothing realistic about this game.

I ABSOLUTELY DON’T RECOMMEND anyone to buy FC 27 after what FC 26 was.

FC 26 is one of the most unoptimized games I’ve ever touched. The game is even LAGGY IN THE MENUS, for God’s sake. I’ve had to disable all the bullsh*t cutscenes, in-background videos and overlays to make the menu barely usable. It is ridiculous, considering that you spend a good 50% of your playtime in the menu, especially in Ultimate Team. And it still randomly breaks, so you have to completely restart the game. And even then EA has the nerve to lock certain actions for UT behind their fu*king web companion. I hope you rot in hell.

Let’s talk about mechanics. They’re terrible. A lot of variation in mechanics, but they’re either completely broken or they don’t work at all.
Passing is awful. Tapping or holding the pass button makes absolutely no difference in 99% of cases. It will pass to the player you’re generally aiming at, with an emphasis on “generally”. For some reason, if two players are nearby, the game simply refuses to pass to the player that is not marked by an opponent. Passing within the box is HELL. I can’t even count the number of times I was on the edge of the box and wanted to pass to the center of the box, tapped the pass button and it sent the ball to the player on the CENTER OF THE FIELD. Through…
Laggy pos, menu's don't work, horribly optimized for pc, incredibly toxic yet i still keep buying the game every year 11 years later (I hate myself evidently)

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the user interface as uninspired, featuring a corporate website color palette and mediocre menu design.

citations.review_text:
Never have I played a game in a series that feels like it had its soul sucked out of it as much as this  one.

The UI color palette looks like it was taken from an underbaked corporate website, the menu design is mid at best and half of the music could be playing whilst you're on hold during a doctor's appointment phone call.

The graphics would be pretty good if it weren't for the numerous bugs, the camera movement is still mediocre for a title thats now in its 20th iteration or so. But hey, the commentators are very good! (The German ones, that is.)

The gameplay is very clearly designed for short passing combinations: So much so that they made the defensive AI purposely leave gaps so that even the worst players can still find a way through. If you're not quickly enough back with your character during a counter, you can see your team get torn apart with 1-2 quick passes. Sometimes CBs won't event try to close done an attacker.

The game also suffers from feature bloat (which admittedly is kind of the norm for long standing titles). You can buy your character a trampoline in career mode or make him take dance classes! I don't really have a problem with those, although some really are horrible balanced (like your standing with the manager: Train well once and you're an instant starter, shoot 5 goals in a match and your manager barely cares).

I bought this game after digging out FIFA 15 again and having a fun time with it. I couldn't get warm with this one despite giving it multiple tries. Don't get me wrong, the game hasn't gotten worse, it just also hasn't improved (except for the graphics and the commentators).

All in all, this game is just not enjoyable. If you're looking to buy a football themed game, buy FM24 or maybe one of the older FIFA titles. Or, idk, go play it outside yourself. This game is not worth your time.

[h2]2/5[/h2]

Last FIFA game I bought was FIFA 16. After that one, I said "NEVER AGAIN”. It's been 10 years since then. Many things around the franchise changed. But this year, I bought it because I saw a couple of friends playing it. I missed the feeling of building the Ultimate Team.

My verdict? I don’t think there is one single online game as broken as FC 26. Simply nothing about this game is even remotely functional. The game keeps throwing so much random sh*t at you which your mind could never have foreseen. There are so many things wrong with this game that I simply can’t address them all. And it’s barely football. It’s so arcadey, there is nothing realistic about this game.

I ABSOLUTELY DON’T RECOMMEND anyone to buy FC 27 after what FC 26 was.

FC 26 is one of the most unoptimized games I’ve ever touched. The game is even LAGGY IN THE MENUS, for God’s sake. I’ve had to disable all the bullsh*t cutscenes, in-background videos and overlays to make the menu barely usable. It is ridiculous, considering that you spend a good 50% of your playtime in the menu, especially in Ultimate Team. And it still randomly breaks, so you have to completely restart the game. And even then EA has the nerve to lock certain actions for UT behind their fu*king web companion. I hope you rot in hell.

Let’s talk about mechanics. They’re terrible. A lot of variation in mechanics, but they’re either completely broken or they don’t work at all.
Passing is awful. Tapping or holding the pass button makes absolutely no difference in 99% of cases. It will pass to the player you’re generally aiming at, with an emphasis on “generally”. For some reason, if two players are nearby, the game simply refuses to pass to the player that is not marked by an opponent. Passing within the box is HELL. I can’t even count the number of times I was on the edge of the box and wanted to pass to the center of the box, tapped the pass button and it sent the ball to the player on the CENTER OF THE FIELD. citations.review_text: My first ever Fifa and probably my last. I did not realize it would be this bad. Lot of people complaining about rewards and the objectives but the main issue is the gameplay: Just god awful. Feels like I'm playing a janky arcade rather than a football simulator.

Nice game, the best in soccer games today
★★★★★☆☆☆☆☆

Positives
- Good graphics
- Very good and diversified audio comments
- Nice features in career mode
- Numerous modes (on line, world cup, career as a player or as a manager, ...)

Negatives
- Some bugs, though not really a problem (more a nuisance than anything else)
- Extremely poor realism against AI (too arcade-like): barely any foul, cards, injuries (even with option on)

This game is really good in 1vs1 or against friends, coop, etc... generally speaking. But against AI, it's far too arcade-like: you'll see very very few defensive tackles. So no cards, injuries, ...

For me, this is the real negative problem in this opus.

If you already own one edition, I would advise do not buy, until EA makes really a realistic soccer game, especially if you want to play against AI.
